p: man of the house of Levi: This Levite was called Amram, who married Jochebed in Ex 6:20.
put the child therein: Committing him to the providence of God, whom she could not keep from the rage of the tyrant.
child's mother: Man's counsel cannot hinder that which God has determined shall come to pass.
grown: That is, was forty years old; Ac 7:23.
slew the Egyptian: Being assured that God had appointed him to deliver the Israelites; Ac 7:25.
feared: Though by his fear he showed his weakness, yet faith covered it; He 11:27.
call him: In which he demonstrated a thankful mind, which would reward the good done to his.
cried: God humbles his by afflictions, that they should cry to him, and receive the fruit of his promise.
respect unto them: He judges their causes or acknowledged them as his own.
